ChangeDomainDescription: Changing the domain name may cause some systems' failure. After changing the domain name you will need to reconfigure the following settings: mail, account, jabber parameters.
ConfigurationDescription: You need to connect your domain to your current IP to change the address settings. Please make sure you have access to the domain settings to be able to do that. After connecting the domain, create a name for your workspace. You can change the created name later using the workspace settings.
CreateSpaceDescription: You have successfully connected your domain to your IP address. To edit the workspace address settings, you need to set the future {{productName}} name

DeleteWarning: The last full access workspace cannot be deleted
DomainNotFound: Domain not found, please check in DNS settings
EncryptDataDescription: {{organizationName}} uses AES-256 encryption to protect data at rest in storage.

Don't forget to disable automatic backups and stop all the running ones. Otherwise, it will be done automatically.
EncryptWarningDialogContent: All workspaces will become unavailable during the encryption process. Are you sure you want to continue?
